fees.launcherFeeRecipientEnforcement: hardcoded constant, not a constructor argument

tickerRegistry.tributeShareHuman: 20% of a derivative's own creator share
tickerRegistry.tributeSource: derivative's creator share only; launcher and builder shares are never touched
tickerRegistry.symbolNormalization: ASCII case-fold only; non-ASCII lookalikes are distinct tickers by design
tickerRegistry.claimReassignment: a confirmed claim is permanent; only an unclaimed or lapsed claim can be taken by a new confirmation

dependencies.note: Revisions are those installed by scripts/bootstrap-deps.sh and must be pinned before release.
